intent: Increase wheel_track slightly from 0.13 to 0.135 to regain some stability lost at 0.13 while preserving improved agility; keep sensor_size at 0.008 to maintain sharp edge detection; adjust sensor x-positions by ±0.007 to optimize sensor spacing and coverage, aiming to reduce residual steering oscillations and line loss events. These changes respond directly to integrator feedback and race telemetry showing a trade-off between agility and stability and residual oscillations despite previous geometry improvements.
rationale: Integrator feedback and race telemetry show that narrowing wheel_track to 0.13 improved agility but caused the controller to reduce base_speed to maintain stability, indicating some loss of stability. The smaller sensor_size of 0.008 sharpened edge detection but required increased controller gains to handle oscillations. Adjusting sensor x-coordinates by ±0.005 previously helped but residual oscillations and line loss events remain, especially on the s-bend track. Increasing wheel_track slightly to 0.135 should restore some stability without sacrificing much agility, helping the controller maintain higher base_speed and reduce oscillations. Keeping sensor_size at 0.008 preserves sharp edge detection benefits. Adjusting sensor x-positions by ±0.007 further optimizes sensor coverage to reduce sensor overlap and improve signal clarity, which should help reduce steering oscillations and line loss events. Body length, width, mass, and wheel radius remain unchanged to maintain a stable baseline. I request measurements of completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, and line_loss_events to evaluate the impact of these geometry adjustments in the next race.
